import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R

# Helper: pose -> 4x4 homogeneous transform
def pose_to_T(pos, quat_wxyz):
    T = np.eye(4)
    T[:3, :3] = R.from_quat([quat_wxyz[1], quat_wxyz[2], quat_wxyz[3], quat_wxyz[0]]).as_matrix()
    T[:3, 3] = pos
    return T

def T_to_pose(T):
    q_xyzw = R.from_matrix(T[:3, :3]).as_quat()
    return T[:3, 3].copy(), np.array([q_xyzw[3], q_xyzw[0], q_xyzw[1], q_xyzw[2]])

# Start from a good configuration
goto_home_joint_position()
open_gripper()

# Get nut center pose and handle grasp pose (same rigid body)
nut_pos, nut_quat = get_object_pose("white hollow center of the brown square nut")
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = sample_grasp_pose("extruded handle of the brown square nut")

T_world_nut = pose_to_T(nut_pos, nut_quat)
T_world_grasp = pose_to_T(grasp_pos, grasp_quat)

# Fixed rigid transform from nut center frame to grasp (end-effector) frame
T_nut_grasp = np.linalg.inv(T_world_nut) @ T_world_grasp

# Grasp the handle with an approach from above
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper()

# Lift the nut
lift_pos = grasp_pos.copy()
lift_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# Get peg (block) pose
peg_pos, peg_quat = get_object_pose("brown square block")

# Desired nut center pose: at the peg position, keep the nut's current orientation
# (position only is matched; orientation of the nut is kept as grasped so that
# the gripper orientation stays the same as the grasp quaternion)
T_world_nut_target = np.eye(4)
T_world_nut_target[:3, :3] = T_world_nut[:3, :3]
T_world_nut_target[:3, 3] = peg_pos

# Compute required end-effector pose so the nut center ends up over the peg
T_world_ee_target = T_world_nut_target @ T_nut_grasp
ee_target_pos, ee_target_quat = T_to_pose(T_world_ee_target)

# Insert: move above the peg first, then descend onto it
goto_pose(ee_target_pos, ee_target_quat, z_approach=0.15)

# Release and retreat
open_gripper()
retreat_pos = ee_target_pos.copy()
retreat_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(retreat_pos, ee_target_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
